answer: Tide-Terrace Proof — 3,000 epoch-actions per 1,000 fakes: each identity keeps a public terrace of one verifiable action per epoch, and nothing earns until it has ridden 3 full tide cycles of consistent actions. A farm spinning up 1,000 fakes must sustain 3,000 epoch-actions of real work before a single payout lands. Anyone can audit the terrace; a wander pattern — actions that drift, repeat, or go silent — triggers a challenge that slashes the stake if the identity can't explain it. Cheap to check, ruinous to fake in bulk.
